GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 123 (20 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 462)
APO 500
20 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Release of Blocked Funds to Rupert Enderle
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. Memorandum No. 722(5.3), dated 26 November 1945, and application of Rupert Enderle, dated 20 November 1945, requesting release of funds for publishing purposes.
2. Imperial Japanese Government is directed to grant permission to Rupert Enderle for release of ¥14,000 from his blocked bank account in Hachijuni Ginko, Karuizawa Branch Office, for the purposes only of publishing the books "Jinrin to Ai" (2,000 copies) and "Elements of Logic" (2,000 copies), and payment of admission fees to the newly established Japanese Publishers Association.
3. An acknowledgement of the receipt of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
